tasks.name: html_css
constraints: index.html has a full-viewport <canvas id="c"> and no inline JavaScript
the body background is radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 42%, #0d1633 0%, #050814 55%, #020309 100%)
the scripts load at the end of body in this order: scene.js, engine3d.js, app.js
the HUD is a div with class "hud", position fixed, top 14px, left 14px, width 268px
the HUD background is rgba(20, 30, 60, 0.38) with backdrop-filter blur(14px)
the HUD border is 1px solid rgba(120, 220, 255, 0.22) with border-radius 12px
the HUD title reads NEON PORTAL 3D on one line, bold, letter-spaced, next to a small badge TANDEM MCP
three stat cells in a 3-column grid hold <b id="fps">, <b id="polys">, <b id="parts"> over the labels FPS, POLYS, PARTS
three buttons in one flex row have ids btnPause (Pause), btnOrbit (Orbit ON), btnReset (Reset)
buttons use background rgba(0, 200, 255, 0.12) and border 1px solid rgba(0, 220, 255, 0.3)
the slider is <input type="range" id="speed" min="0.2" max="3.0" step="0.1" value="1.0"> with accent-color #ff4fd8
the slider readout is 1.0x
tasks.goal: Create index.html, the page shell of a 3D neon portal demo: a full-viewport canvas id="c" and a compact glassmorphism HUD, exactly as the constraints state.
verify_commands: for i in c fps polys parts btnPause btnOrbit btnReset speed spdVal; do grep -q "id=\"$i\"" index.html || exit 1; done

tasks.name: scene_data
constraints: scene.js sets window.Scene = { build } and uses no import or export
build() returns a new object { faces, crystals, stars, particles } on every call
faces holds 36 quads, the 6 faces of 6 axis-aligned boxes
each face is { pts: four [x, y, z] corners in loop order, color: [r, g, b], glow: number }
lower platform tier box: center (0, -1.45, 0), size (5.6, 0.4, 3.6)
upper platform tier box: center (0, -1.05, 0), size (4.2, 0.4, 2.4)
left pillar box: center (-1.25, 0.42, 0), size (0.5, 2.55, 0.5)
right pillar box: center (1.25, 0.42, 0), size (0.5, 2.55, 0.5)
lintel box: center (0, 1.95, 0), size (3.4, 0.5, 0.7)
crown cap box: center (0, 2.32, 0), size (2.2, 0.24, 0.5), glow 0.3
box colors are dark obsidian blue with every channel between 20 and 95 and glow 0.05 to 0.15
crystals holds 6 items { angle: i * Math.PI / 3, color, spin, phase: i * 1.7 }
crystal colors alternate cyan [40, 225, 255] and magenta [255, 70, 215]
crystal spin is between 0.9 and 1.6
stars holds 180 items { p: [x, y, z], size, rate, phase } on a sphere of radius 42 with y >= -4
star size is 0.5 to 1.7, rate 0.7 to 3.1, phase 0 to 2 * Math.PI
particles holds 110 items { x, y, z, v, sway, hue, size } with (x, z) inside a disc of radius 3.4
particle y is -1.9 to 3.5, v 0.35 to 1.1, hue 188 or 312, size 0.02 to 0.055
tasks.goal: Create scene.js, a plain browser script that sets window.Scene = { build }: the data of a neon portal gate (36 box faces, 6 crystals, 180 stars, 110 particles), y axis up, exactly as the constraints state.
verify_commands: node -e "global.window=global;require('./scene.js');const s=window.Scene.build();const n=[s.faces.length,s.crystals.length,s.stars.length,s.particles.length].join();if(n!=='36,6,180,110'){console.error('counts',n,'expected 36,6,180,110');process.exit(1)}if(s.faces.some(f=>f.pts.length!==4||f.color.length!==3)){console.error('each face needs 4 pts and an rgb color');process.exit(1)}"

tasks.name: engine3d
constraints: window.Engine3D exposes init, setSpeed, togglePause, toggleOrbit, reset, getStats
init(canvas) sizes the canvas to innerWidth x innerHeight times devicePixelRatio, again on window resize
init calls window.Scene.build() once and starts a requestAnimationFrame loop
dragging with the pointer changes yaw and pitch
camera defaults are yaw 0.55, pitch 0.34, dist 9.6, fov 580, target [0, 0.35, 0]
projection, after subtracting the target: x1 = x*cos(yaw) - z*sin(yaw) and z1 = x*sin(yaw) + z*cos(yaw)
projection: y2 = y*cos(pitch) + z1*sin(pitch) and z2 = -y*sin(pitch) + z1*cos(pitch)
depth = z2 + dist, and a point with depth < 0.2 is skipped
s = fov * view / depth with view = Math.min(W / 1180, H / 720)
screen x = W / 2 + x1 * s and screen y = H / 2 - y2 * s, in CSS pixels
time advances by dt * speed unless paused, with dt capped at 0.05
yaw grows by 0.22 * dt * speed while orbit is on
the canvas is cleared with clearRect every frame and never filled with a background color
stars are drawn as small squares whose alpha twinkles with sin(time * rate + phase)
the grid floor is at y = -2.0 with lines every 1 unit from -12 to 12 on x and on z
every 4th grid line is a brighter cyan than the others
each crystal is an octahedron of 8 triangles with half height 0.42 and half width 0.24
crystal center is x = 2.45*cos(a), z = 2.45*sin(a) with a = crystal.angle + 0.35*time
crystal height is y = 0.5 + 0.28*sin(1.4*time + crystal.phase)
crystals rotate around the Y axis by time * crystal.spin
polygon brightness = 0.42 + 0.95 * max(0, normal . light) + glow with light = normalize(0.45, 0.8, -0.4)
polygons are filled with rgb(color * brightness) and stroked with a thin cyan outline, white for crystals
polygons are sorted by mean depth and drawn far to near
the portal is drawn inside that same depth order at [0, 0.55, 0], not always on top
the portal core is a radial gradient white, cyan, magenta, transparent of radius 1.05 units drawn with "lighter"
the portal core radius pulses slowly with a sine of time
two tilted rings are 3D polylines of radius 1.0 (cyan) and 0.78 (magenta) that rotate in opposite directions
particles are drawn last as additive dots colored with hsl from particle.hue
each particle rises by v * dt and returns to y = -1.9 when it passes y = 3.6
togglePause() and toggleOrbit() return the new boolean state
reset() restores the default camera values and time 0
getStats() returns { fps, polys, parts } with polys = polygons filled in the last frame (84) and parts = 110
tasks.goal: Create engine3d.js, a plain browser script (no import/export) that sets window.Engine3D: a software 3D renderer on the 2D canvas context that draws the object returned by window.Scene.build() (read scene.js for its shape), exactly as the constraints state.

tasks.name: app_loop
constraints: app.js calls window.Engine3D.init(document.getElementById("c"))
#btnPause reads "Play" when togglePause() returns true, else "Pause"
#btnOrbit reads "Orbit ON" when toggleOrbit() returns true, else "Orbit OFF"
#btnReset calls reset()
the input event of #speed calls setSpeed(parseFloat(value))
#spdVal shows the speed with one decimal followed by x
every 500 ms getStats() is written into #fps (rounded), #polys and #parts
tasks.goal: Create app.js, a plain browser script that starts window.Engine3D on the canvas id="c" and wires the HUD controls of index.html, exactly as the constraints state.
